prompt:
Image 1 is a frame from our film and is the authority for this building's design and weathering: the tall two-storey weathered timber building on the right side of the street in Image 1, with a covered boardwalk porch and a balcony. Recreate it as a freestanding building: a tall square false front of vertical grey-brown board-and-batten planks, a full-width covered porch on square posts with a balcony railing above it, three tall upper windows and two lower windows beside a plank door, a raised plank boardwalk floor.
Framing: one single image (not a collage, not a reference sheet) of only this building, seen in a three-quarter front view from slightly above eye level, the whole building in frame from its foundation to its roofline with clear margin on every side. It fills most of the frame.
Setting: it stands alone on a plain, seamless light-grey studio backdrop with a matching grey floor. No street, no dirt road, no sky, no hills, no other buildings, no people, no animals, no vehicles, no props other than those named above.
Light: soft, even, neutral studio light from the front, no harsh shadows, no sunset glow, no warm cast, no light coming from inside windows. Glass reads as dark, slightly reflective panes.
Materials are physical and real: sun-split grey-brown planks with deep grain, nail streaks, faded remnants of old paint, warped boards, dusty boardwalk. Photographic realism, natural colour, full-bleed image filling the whole frame; no film border, no caption, no watermark, no text, no lettering, no logos; any sign board is blank wood. Not an illustration, not a painting, no HDR, no sharpening.
